title: HoustonView
description: Response of GET /ui/crew/{astronaut_id}/houston: what goes to the ground station and the state of the link, for the Houston screen of the desktop UI. Codes and data only; every unknown is an explicit null. The transport is simulated and the content is not yet validated by Aguado: the UI shows both.

summary.description: Latest summary prepared for the ground; null while the astronaut has nothing yet.

ground_link.description: State of the link with the ground station; null when not configured or unknown.

last_contact_at.description: Instant of the last confirmed send to the ground station; null when there is none yet.

transport.description: How the summaries reach the ground. Today always 'simulated': the UI marks it as such.

content_validated.description: Whether the content of the summary has been validated by Aguado. Today always false: the UI shows it as pending.
